area: Tiered Pricing and the two new reports
title: Columns that move between the design's own pictures
stem: Should columns and boxes keep their place when a screen changes state, or are the moves the design's pictures show intended?

options.t: Keep their place: nothing moves sideways or down when a row opens or closes, a search narrows a list, a list is empty, a filter chip changes, the Add Part row opens or a page switches between view and edit
options.why: columns that jump make a screen hard to read and compare

context: Comparing the design's pictures of the same screen: the Price Part Simulator's columns move between view and edit (Part Cost about 70 pixels wider in edit); on New Matrix, opening the categories list pushes the tabs and grid down about 221 pixels; on Manage Customers the tier columns move left 11 to 83 pixels when a search narrows the list; on Sales by Tier the number columns move 58 to 94 pixels when a row or a customer is opened and 20 to 36 pixels on the empty states; on Sales by Category they move 5 to 10 pixels when a category is opened; the report filter chips shift as a picked chip widens; on a work order the lines table's columns move 19 to 71 pixels while the Add Part row is open and 1 to 9 pixels after a part is added or received. The PRD says layout follows the design, but nothing says whether these moves are meant or just drawn that way.
where: Tiered Pricing design canvas, pictures 3.5 and 3.25, 3.10 and 4.7, 3.22 and 3.23 (simulator, New Matrix); 9.4, 9.12, 9.13 (Manage Customers); 20.2 to 20.4, 20.9, 20.11, 20.16 and 20.17, 20.21 to 20.23 (reports); 10.5 to 10.9, 11.7 (work order); PRD section 7 (layout follows the design)
